Floor fungus is identical to [[cave moss]], except for the color.

As with [[Caverns#Benefits|most underground grasses]], floor fungus only appears after a [[cavern]] containing floor fungus has been discovered.

It is harmless and can be used to graze animals, like an underground form of [[grass]].
